response.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS country, p.player_id AS player_id, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS player_avg FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, ''), p.player_id), ca AS (SELECT country, AVG(player_avg) AS country_avg FROM pv GROUP BY country) SELECT country, country_avg, country_avg / (SELECT AVG(country_avg) FROM ca) AS ratio_to_mean FROM ca
